programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in comp), max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in comp), max(x for y,x in comp)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            cells = set(comp)
            border = {(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                      if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            interior = [(y,x) for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)]
            if cells == border and all(grid[y][x] == bg for y,x in interior):
                fill = 2 if len(interior) == 4 else 7
                for y,x in interior:
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
file=programs/'task-314ce108.py'
file.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(file),'exec'),globals())
